description: Details required by condition 3(a, d, f, g, i)(submission of details - (a) Colour of new rubber membrane roof covering to rear extensions; (d) New external vents, including colour/finish; (f) Means of ventilating new kitchen to rear main room at upper ground floor level (RM 0004); (g) Notwithstanding the approved drawings, extent of alteration and/or removal of existing skirtings in rear main room at upper ground floor level (RM 0004); (i) New applied hard flooring, including samples and section showing relationship to retained skirtings; Please note that this condition does not apply to replacement floorboards.) of listed building consent 26/00127 (Refurbishment of 22 Cheyne Row to include the repair and refurbishment of the rear fa‡ade, flat roofs, parapets and rainwater goods, and upgrades to services along with various internal alterations to restore the building.)
